Adit Singh @ Aditya Singh
2. Smt. Sunaina Devi ... Petitioners Versus The State of Jharkhand & Anr. ... Opposite Parties
Coram: Hon'Ble
MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY For the Petitioners :

Mr. Jitesh Kumar ,Adv.
 For the State : Mr. S.K.Shukla ,Addl.

Apprehending their arrest, the petitioners have moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 21 of 2022 registered under Sections 341,
323, 504, 506, 498A, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the D.P.Act.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the allegation against the petitioners is that the petitioners being the father-in-law and mother-in-law, treated the opp. party no. 2 with cruelty in connection with demand of dowry.
It is then submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are all false and the main allegation is against the husband of the opp. party no. 2.

It is next submitted that the petitioners are ready to co-operate with the investigation of the case hence,
the petitioners be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
The learned Addl. PP opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.
Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Hence, in the event of arrest by the police or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, the petitioners shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned SDJM, Chatra in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 21 of 2022 subject to the condition that the petitioners will co-operate with the Investigation of the case and will appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will submit mobile number and photocopy of Aadhaar card at the time of surrender in the court below with an Adit Singh @ Aditya Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. ... ... on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161605401/
1 undertaking not to change mobile number during the pendency of the case along with the other conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C. (ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY, J.) Smita/-
